name: Rust Cache
description: A GitHub Action that implements smart caching for rust/cargo projects with sensible defaults.

prefix-key.description: The prefix cache key, this can be changed to start a new cache manually.

shared-key.description: A cache key that is used instead of the automatic `job`-based key, and is stable over multiple jobs.

key.description: An additional cache key that is added alongside the automatic `job`-based cache key and can be used to further differentiate jobs.

add-job-id-key.description: If the automatic `job`-based cache key should include the job id. Defaults to true.

add-rust-environment-hash-key.description: Weather the a hash of the rust environment should be included in the cache key. This includes a hash of all Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock files, rust-toolchain files, a

env-vars.description: Additional environment variables to include in the cache key, separated by spaces.

workspaces.description: Paths to multiple Cargo workspaces and their target directories, separated by newlines.

cache-directories.description: Additional non workspace directories to be cached, separated by newlines.

cache-targets.description: Determines whether workspace targets are cached. If `false`, only the cargo registry will be cached.

cache-on-failure.description: Cache even if the build fails. Defaults to false.

cache-all-crates.description: Determines which crates are cached. If `true` all crates will be cached, otherwise only dependent crates will be cached.

cache-workspace-crates.description: Similar to cache-all-crates. If `true` the workspace crates will be cached.

save-if.description: Determiners whether the cache should be saved. If `false`, the cache is only restored.

cache-provider.description: Determines which provider to use for caching. Options are github, or warpbuild. Defaults to github.

lookup-only.description: Check if a cache entry exists without downloading the cache

cmd-format.description: A format string used to format commands to be run, i.e. `rustc` and `cargo`.
